description: Full-text search of the ordinances, court orders, development regulations, fee schedules and permit pages we downloaded for a Texas county or city. Returns matching passages with their source URL and download date, so an answer can quote the code. Pass the AHJ (name or location) and a question or keywords, e.g. 'battery storage setback' or 'industrial user wastewater permit'. Enterprise.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

name: ask_code
title: Search a county or city code
